With $\beta>0$ we expand the product of two occupations,
\begin{align}
\frac{1}{e^{\beta x}+1}\,\frac{1}{e^{-\beta x}+1} &= \frac{e^{\beta x}}{\left(e^{\beta x}+1\right)^2} \nonumber\\
&\qquad \frac{1}{2}\left(1 + e^{\beta x}\right) - \frac{1}{2}\left(1+e^{\beta x}\right) \label{eq:cont}
\end{align}
and similarly
\begin{align}
\left(a + b\right)^2 &= a^2 + 2ab \nonumber\\
& \quad\; b^2 . \label{eq:sq}
\end{align}
